description: A dark cup sits on the bed in front of a pillow, with a Pepsi bottle to the right. The right hand moves in and grips the Pepsi bottle as a right-hand object, while the left hand reaches forward to grasp and lift the cup as a left-hand object; the left hand tilts the cup slightly and the right hand rotates the bottle neck toward the cup in a pouring motion, then both hands bring their objects back upright.
